31924-IXB.s: This bill amends the 2008 budget statement (slotwet) of the Ministry of Finance, adjusting the appropriations and expenditure figures and the statement for the benefit-based service Domeinen Roerende en Onroerende Zaken to match realised outcomes. It is a routine budgetary closing act that changes no delegations or institutional powers.
q: Is amended, as shown in the corresponding statement attached to this act.
Wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32360-VII.s: This bill amends the 2009 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations, adjusting appropriations, expenditure and revenue across policy articles to match realised figures. It also sets the effective date of the law and its retroactive operation to 31 December of the budget year.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (VII) for the year 2009 is amended as shown in the statement attached to this law.

De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) voor het jaar 2009 wordt gewijzigd, zoals blijkt uit de desbetreffende bij deze wet behorende staat.

32565-XI.s: This bill amends the 2010 budget statements (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Housing, Spatial Planning and the Environment (XI) and for the Waddenfonds, mainly through a second supplementary budget tied to the autumn budget review. It also sets the ministry's budget as part of the State Budget for 2010, assigns budget management to the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment, and provides retroactive effect from 14 October 2010.
32565-XI.j: The explanatory memorandum justifies the budget changes as technical adjustments tied to the Najaarsnota and reallocations such as compensation for the Raad van State and deficits in the inspectorate's apparatus budget.
q: For the year 2010, in addition to article 51, first paragraph, under b, of the Comptabiliteitswet 2001, the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment, in agreement with the Minister of Interior and Kingdom Relations and the Minister of Economic Affairs, Agriculture and Innovation, accounts for the policy pursued and the business operations in the annual report.

Voor het jaar 2010 geldt, in aanvulling op artikel 51, eerste lid, aanhef en onder b, van de Comptabiliteitswet 2001, dat Onze Minister van Infrastructuur en Milieu, in overeenstemming met Onze Minister van Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties en Onze Minister van Economische Zaken, Landbouw en Innovatie, verantwoording aflegt over het gevoerde beleid en de bedrijfsvoering
p: Assigns budget management of the Volkshuisvesting, Ruimtelijke Ordening en Milieubeheer budget to the Minister of Infrastructure and Environment from 14 October 2010, subject to accountability through the annual report.

32780-IXA.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statement for the National Debt (IXA) following the Spring Memorandum, raising expenditure and receipts for debt financing and cash management. It is a budget amendment that adjusts appropriation amounts and takes effect on 1 June 2011.
q: Debt financing at the lowest possible interest cost under acceptable risk for the budget.
Schuldfinanciering tegen zo laag mogelijke rentekosten onder acceptabel risico voor de begroting.

33240-XII.s: This bill amends the 2011 budget statements (slotwet) of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Environment, the Waddenfonds, and the baten-lastendiensten, adjusting expenditure, revenue and commitment amounts. It contains only technical and bookkeeping adjustments and enters into force retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: This bill contains only technical implementation adjustments, bookkeeping-type adjustments, or adjustments arising from audit findings.
In dit wetsvoorstel zijn alleen technische uitvoeringsmutaties, mutaties van boekhoudkundige aard of mutaties voortvloeiend uit controlebevindingen opgenomen.

34475-IV.s: This bill amends the 2015 budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) by adjusting commitments, expenditures and receipts per policy article, as set out in an attached schedule. It also sets the budget in thousands of euros and makes the law effective from the day after gazetting, retroactive to 31 December of the budget year.
q: Whereas We have considered that the need has arisen to amend the budget statement of Kingdom Relations (IV) for the year 2015
Alzo Wij in overweging genomen hebben, dat de noodzaak is gebleken van een wijziging van de begrotingsstaat van Koninkrijksrelaties (IV) voor het jaar 2015

34475-VI.s: This bill (Slotwet 2015) amends the 2015 departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice and the agency budget statements for that year, adjusting appropriations and realised figures. It sets the amounts in thousands of euros and provides for entry into force retroactive to 31 December 2015.
q: We Willem-Alexander ... have resolved and decided ... The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Security and Justice (VI) for the year 2015 is amended
Wij Willem-Alexander ... hebben goedgevonden en verstaan ... De departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Veiligheid en Justitie (VI) voor het jaar 2015 wordt gewijzigd

34725-IX.s: The bill amends the 2016 departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA) through a supplementary closing budget law, setting figures in thousands of euros and taking effect the day after publication in the Staatsblad with retroactive effect to 31 December 2016. It shifts budget appropriations between articles without altering statutory powers or oversight structures.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and of the National Debt budget statement (IXA), both for the year 2016
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Financiën (IXB), en van de begrotingsstaat van de Nationale Schuld (IXA), beide voor het jaar 2016

34950-IX.s: This bill (slotwet) amends the 2017 budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA), setting final expenditure, revenue and commitment figures in thousands of euros. It enters into force the day after publication in the Staatsblad and applies retroactively to 31 December of the budget year.
q: We, with the joint consultation of the States General, have approved and resolved
Wij met gemeen overleg der Staten-Generaal, hebben goedgevonden en verstaan

35000-XV.s: This document is the 2019 budget bill for the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment, which formally fixes the departmental budget statement with appropriations and receipts in thousands of euros. The accompanying explanatory memorandum covers policy areas such as labour market, social security, childcare, pensions and inspection, but as excerpted it contains no provisions delegating rule-making power or shifting power away from checks.
q: The departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Social Affairs and Employment (XV) for the year 2019, attached to this law, is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Sociale Zaken en Werkgelegenheid (XV) voor het jaar 2019 wordt vastgesteld.

35850-IX.s: This is the first supplementary budget bill (eerste suppletoire begroting) for 2021, amending the departmental budget of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt budget (IXA). It adjusts appropriations, revenue and financing figures across policy articles such as taxes, financial markets, and debt financing, effective from 1 June 2021.

36120-XII.s: The bill amends the 2022 budget statements of the Ministry of Infrastructure and Water Management and of its executive agencies (first supplementary budget), raising total expenditure and commitments across policy articles. It also adjusts the financial statements of agencies RWS and KNMI, including additional funding for the ILT inspectorate and aviation oversight.
36120-XII.j: The memorandum justifies the extra funding for the ILT inspectorate by the need for more capacity in aviation regulation, licensing and supervision.
q: Good supervision is inseparably linked to strengthening licensing and sound, enforceable regulation.
Goed toezicht hangt onlosmakelijk samen met het versterken van de vergunningverlening en goede (handhaafbare) regelgeving.

36410-VII.s: The bill sets the 2024 departmental budget statement for the Ministry of the Interior and Kingdom Relations (BZK) and the budget statements for its agencies, in thousands of euros. It also fixes the entry-into-force rules, and the attached explanatory memorandum extract covers policy priorities such as constitutional review, the rijksinspecties framework and housing, without new delegations of rule-making power.
q: The departmental budget statement attached to this act for the year 2024 is hereby established.
De bij deze wet behorende departementale begrotingsstaat voor het jaar 2024 wordt vastgesteld.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State issued an opinion dated 11 September 2023 on the draft 2024 budget act (begrotingsstaten) for the Ministry of Binnenlandse Zaken en Koninkrijksrelaties (VII) and related funds, and found no remarks on the proposal. The accompanying nader rapport of 18 September 2023 is included, but the text provides no reply to any specific point because the Afdeling raised none.

36435-IX.s: The bill amends the 2023 budget statements of the Ministry of Finance (IXB) and the National Debt (IXA) through a supplementary budget submitted on Budget Day, with amounts in thousands of euros and retroactive effect to 19 September 2023. The explanatory memorandum justifies the mutations mainly by a reduced compensation budget for SNS REAAL Holding after a Supreme Court ruling and a cash shift of funds to later years.
36435-IX.j: The memorandum justifies the budget changes by the Supreme Court ruling of 21 April 2023 fixing the SNS REAAL compensation and by postponing payments to later years because processing will take months and objections or appeals may follow.
q: Therefore, via a cash shift, budget from 2023 has been postponed to later years.
Daarom is via een kasschuif budget uit 2023 doorgeschoven naar latere jaren.

36725-IV.s: This first supplementary budget bill amends the 2025 budget statements for Kingdom Relations (IV) and the BES-fund (H), shifting several hundred million euros between articles and years. It also sets the bill's entry-into-force and retroactive effect to 1 June 2025.

36725-VI.s: This first supplementary budget for 2025 amends the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security and the budget statement for its agencies, raising spending and revenue lines across police, justice, prisons and other articles. It takes effect the day after publication and is made retroactive to 1 June 2025.
q: Amendment of the departmental budget statement of the Ministry of Justice and Security and of the budget statement for the agencies of this ministry, all for the year 2025.
Wijziging van de departementale begrotingsstaat van het Ministerie van Justitie en Veiligheid (VI) en van de begrotingsstaat inzake de agentschappen van dit ministerie, alle voor het jaar 2025.

36899.s: The bill amends the Fisheries Act 1963 to raise the maximum administrative fine for violations to the sixth fine category of the Dutch Criminal Code or ten percent of the offender's turnover, whichever is higher. It also renames the responsible minister and makes a conforming change in article 54d, implementing the revised EU fisheries control regulation.
36899.j: The memorandum justifies the higher fine ceiling by the need to comply with the revised EU control regulation, which requires proportionate and deterrent sanctions for serious infringements.
q: Article 54c, paragraph 3, of the Fisheries Act 1963 must for that reason be amended to comply with the revised control regulation.
Artikel 54c, derde lid, van de Visserijwet 1963 moet om die reden worden aangepast om aan de herziene controleverordening te voldoen.

parties: Asks how the NVWA can apply the new maximum fines immediately, how coordination with the Public Prosecution Service works, and whether the fine regime is proportionate and unclear provisions have caused legal complications.
These members ask the government to clarify which technical or organisational obstacles currently exist at the NVWA to fully implement this fines regime.

Aanleiding en doel De leden van de D66-fractie vragen de regering te verduidelijken welke technische of organisatorische belemmeringen er op dit moment zijn bij de Nederlandse Voedsel- en Warenautoriteit (NVWA) om dit boetestelsel volledig te effectueren.
Has no additional questions or remarks on the technical amendment.
At this moment these members have no additional questions or comments.
Op dit moment hebben deze leden geen aanvullende vragen of opmerkingen.
Fears a ten percent turnover fine would bankrupt fishing firms, questions NVWA capacity and whether fishers could be prosecuted twice under administrative and criminal law for the same act.
Can the government guarantee that fishers are not punished twice, under both administrative and criminal law, for the same act?
Kan de regering garanderen dat vissers niet dubbel gepakt worden via zowel het bestuursrecht als het strafrecht voor hetzelfde feit?
Asks about the state of enforcement and control, whether extra capacity is needed, and what measures limit competitive disadvantage for the sector.
They wonder what the current state of affairs is and whether extra capacity is needed to do that sufficiently.
Zij vragen zich af wat de stand van zaken daarop is en of er extra capaciteit nodig is om dat voldoende te kunnen doen.
Asks how much higher the new maximum fine is, how often fines were imposed in recent years, and how control is carried out, including use of onboard cameras.
The JA21 members ask in what way and how frequently these violations are checked.
De leden van de JA21-fractie vragen op welke manier en met welke frequentie op deze overtredingen wordt gecontroleerd.

Argues higher fines are insufficient, asks whether animal welfare is considered when setting fines and in NVWA enforcement, and asks for explicit restrictions on fishing methods causing severe suffering.
The PvdD members hold that merely raising fines is wholly insufficient to end the severe suffering of fish in fishing, because these practices are still permitted under current legislation.

De leden van de PvdD-fractie zijn van mening dat enkel het verhogen van boetes volstrekt onvoldoende is om een einde te maken aan het ernstige lijden van vissen in de visserij, omdat deze praktijken binnen de huidige wetgeving gewoon zijn toegestaan.
Has no additional questions or remarks.
have no additional questions and/or comments on this.
hebben hierover geen aanvullende vragen en/of opmerkingen.

v.summary: The Afdeling advisering of the Raad van State found no remarks on the draft bill amending the Visserijwet 1963 to implement EU Regulation 2023/2842 on fisheries control, specifically the maximum administrative fine. The government's reply reports minor changes: removal of a transitional clause, an updated entry-into-force provision, a footnote, and editorial edits.

36945-III.s: This Slotwet (closing budget act) amends the 2025 departmental budget statements of the Ministry of General Affairs, the Royal Household (Kabinet van de Koning) and the Commissie van Toezicht op de Inlichtingen- en Veiligheidsdiensten, plus the budget of the agency Dienst Publiek en Communicatie, to reflect supplementary budgets and realised spending. It mainly records budget mutations and underspending without creating new executive powers.
q: The underspending of €0.5 million in the CTIVD budget occurs largely in the personnel component, mainly due to a delay in expanding capacity that continued into 2025.

De onderuitputting van € 0,5 miljoen op het budget van de CTIVD doet zich grotendeels voor op het personele deel, met name door een vertraging in de uitbreiding van de capaciteit die doorliep in 2025.
